screenLevelIssues.explanation: The screen displays a bottom sheet modal which requires a specific layering of components and a background blur effect. The implementation must ensure: 1) A blur overlay (`Rectangle 54`) is rendered above the main content but below the sheet. 2) The z-index of all layers (content, floating bar, overlay, sheet) is correct. 3) The blur effect has a radius of 8. A common mistake is to only use a semi-transparent color without the blur, or to have incorrect stacking order.

details.figmaValue: Correct z-index stack (Base -> Bar -> Overlay -> Sheet) with a blur(8) overlay.
details.currentValue: Likely incorrect layering and missing blur effect.

layoutIssues.explanation: The bottom sheet component has incorrect styling. The main container (`Frame 1686557301`) is missing rounded top corners, which are clearly visible in the design. Additionally, the inner content list (`Frame 2095586364`) requires a horizontal padding of 48px to correctly space the payment options from the edges of the sheet.

details.currentValue: Likely missing border radius and using smaller default padding.

scrollIssues.explanation: The main content area is scrollable, but a floating bottom bar (`Frame 1686557229`) with a height of 118px is positioned at the bottom of the screen. The ScrollView's content will be cut off by this bar unless appropriate bottom padding is applied to its content container. The last items in the scroll view are not accessible.

details.currentValue: Not specified, likely 0 or an insufficient value.

feedback.explanation: Multiple text elements in the design use different styles (e.g., colors) within a single line. These must be rendered using a single parent `<Text>` component with nested `<Text>` children for each style segment. Implementing them as separate `<Text>` components or using line breaks will cause incorrect layout and wrapping.
feedback.figmaValue: Single line text with multiple style segments.
feedback.currentValue: Likely implemented as multiple <Text> components, causing incorrect line breaks.
feedback.fixedCode:
/* Correct implementation for 'Your rent is due in 10 days' */
<Text style={styles.baseText}>
  <Text style={{color: colors.neutral[100]}}>Your rent is due{"\n"}</Text>
  <Text style={{color: colors.brand[500]}}>in 10 days</Text>
</Text>

- "CVV •••"
- "ICICI a/c - xxx23"
- "rishabh@•••"
- "Choose a Payment Method" */
